error_reason: The Planner agent repeatedly attempts to verify Pasquale Festa Campanile's birth year (stating it needs confirmation) and repeats the exact same task definition in every turn. Simultaneously, the WebSurfer agent is shown searching for the exact same information (birth date of Campanile) in Turns 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, and 14, often with identical or nearly identical queries.
